# Modrn Magic

> Modrn Magic (modrnmagic.app) is an independent product studio founded by Akhil Jacob in San Diego, California. It designs, builds, and runs its own apps for iPhone, Android, and the web. It does not publish client work on this site.

Key facts:

- Founder: Akhil Jacob, software engineer. Portfolio: https://akhilcjacob.com/
- Legal name: Modrn Magic LLC
- Contact: hello@modrnmagic.app
- Mobile apps are built with Flutter. Web products use Next.js and Firebase.
- Store listings name the seller as Akhil Jacob.

## Products

- [Flowmoro](https://modrnmagic.app/apps/flowmoro/): Flowmoro is a Pomodoro focus timer for iPhone and Android. It keeps the screen quiet, lets you set your own work and break lengths, and collects no data. Available: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flowmoro/id6717611672), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.modrnmagic.flowmoro). Price on the US App Store: $0.99. First released Oct 5, 2024.
- [Astro Defender](https://modrnmagic.app/apps/astrodefender/): Astro Defender is a casual space shooter for iPhone and Android. You sit at the center of the screen, rotate, and shoot down incoming enemies before they reach Earth, earning upgrades as you go. Available: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/astro-defender-cosmic-crusade/id6478248785), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.modrnmagic.astrodefender). Price on the US App Store: free. First released Feb 29, 2024.
- [SkyWise](https://modrnmagic.app/apps/skywise/): SkyWise is a weather app for iPhone and Android with a built-in AI assistant. Alongside the forecast, you can ask plain questions like whether it is a good day for a barbecue or which shoes to wear. Available: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/skywise/id6473301938), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.modrnmagic.skywise). Price on the US App Store: free. First released Feb 13, 2024.
- [InboxHiive](https://modrnmagic.app/apps/inboxhiiv/): InboxHiive turns podcast episodes into clean, readable newsletters. Subscribe to the shows you follow and get an AI-written summary, key insights, and a chapter-by-chapter breakdown of each new episode in your inbox. Available: [Website](https://inboxhiive.com).
- [Nookly](https://modrnmagic.app/apps/nookly/): Nookly books home services without the research. Pick the service, a date, and a time, and a vetted professional takes care of it. Nookly is live in San Diego. Available: [Website](https://nookly.co).

## Lab and archive

- [Triply](https://modrnmagic.app/apps/triply/): Triply is a trip planning prototype. It generates personalized day plans and multi-day itineraries from your preferences, such as how you get around, budget, and the kinds of places you like, and shows them on a map. Status: in the lab, 2025.
- [QuietDesk](https://modrnmagic.app/apps/quietdesk/): QuietDesk is a minimal Android launcher prototype. It replaces the home screen with a clock and a short list of favorite apps, with search for everything else. Status: in the lab, 2024.
- [Quorum](https://modrnmagic.app/apps/quorum/): Quorum was a 2023 prototype for podcasts you could join: live conversations where listeners take part instead of only listening. It ran a waitlist and did not ship. Status: archived, 2023 to 2024.
